description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Potatoes, B'onions, Suger etc., valid for a period of 06 moths commencing from 08.09.2015
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy on various goods through an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains detailed regulatory information about tax rates on specific commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Finance Minister Ravi Karunanayake, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities, making it a regulatory action rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
